known_assets: Map 1 runtime wall/floor/stone source images remain the Wikimedia Commons materials recorded in visuals/spaces-lab/index.html.
Map 1 derives atlas.archBacking at runtime from the existing wall material.
Map 4 reuses the existing stone image, re-graded warm/brown into atlas.tunnel and tiled as atlas.tunnelTile.
Maps 2, 3 and 5 primarily use procedural world-space materials.
Map 5 v19 ritual signs are fully procedural geometry/materials: telescoping post, gold frame, violet inset panel and minimal glyph. No new external image dependency was added.
visuals/spaces-lab/assets/checker-grid.svg remains historical/optional and is not loaded by current runtime.
rule: Reuse stable image materials where mapping stays convincing. Interactive props such as Map 5 proximity signs should remain world-space procedural objects unless a later visual reference demands an image asset.
